## Summary

This PR improves the test suite for `src/validator.js` by adding new test cases that significantly increase mutation-adjusted coverage. No changes were made to `src/ui/`.

## Metrics

| Metric | Before | After |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Coverage | 100% | 100% |
| Mutation Score | 6.25% | 93.75% |
| MAC | 6.25 | 93.75 |

## Changed Test Files

- `test/validator.mac-cov.test.js`
- `test/validator.mac-mut.test.js`

Include a before/after metrics table in PR body
